circuit.notes: Johnson-coil flagged interleaved two-block extraction (max_flags=3 per check, 8 data CX slots per round, X-check term slots [6, 1, 7, 2, 3, 5, 4], Z-check term slots [0, 6, 1, 3, 4, 2, 5] over terms A_0..A_2, B_0..B_3); verified against stim 1.16.0; RIS DEM search found nothing lighter than the claimed d_circ (generator: seed 0xC18C, 12 s per basis; independent re-check: seeds 0x5EED01 and 0x5EED02 at 1.5x the gate's trial budget, 180 s cap per basis)
